h: The Third Meal and the Redemption Within the Heart

p: there is mentioned in the zemiros
of the holy Ari, of blessed memory,
and at the third meal we say,
"to see the radiance of Ze'ir Anpin."
that the holiness of this meal
and it is that there only "light" is mentioned,
only from the radiance of the Shechinah,
which is the attribute of Malchus,
as is written in the holy Zohar:
the head of Ze'ir Anpin is filled
and drops to the holy Field of Apples,"
which is the attribute of Malchus;
and from this we attain the light,
שֶׁהוּא בְּאוֹרְךָ נִרְאֶה אוֹר (תְּהִלִּים לו, י)
which is "In Your light we see light" (Tehillim 36:10),
which is the meal of Yaakov Avinu,
and he is a chariot for the Name Havayah
a semblance of the World to Come,
(as they said at the end of Taanis, 31a).
And this is "to see the radiance of Ze'ir Anpin":
that is, the aspect of the Name Havayah;
and each one points with his finger;
at the splitting of the Yam Suf,
one attains only a semblance of this,
and it is only the radiance of Ze'ir Anpin;
and only "the members of the palace who yearn,"
And it is according to what is stated
on Yishmael and its appointed angel;
and with the left of Yitzchak,
on Esav and its appointed angel,
and with the level of Yaakov, etc.:
עַד כִּי יָבֹא שִׁילֹה (בְּרֵאשִׁית מט, י)
takes vengeance on the Erev Rav, etc."
"From the place of His dwelling He watches" (Tehillim 33:14),
the image of the middle pillar, etc."
And the refuse of Yitzchak Avinu,
which is the kelipah of murder,
who is the aspect of fear and awe,
of the kelipos of the seventy nations:
who is alluded to in the pasuk
with the numerical value of Moshe
as is written in the Ra'aya Mehemna
are the leaven in the dough, etc.,
they hold back more in exile,
and the subjugation to the kingdoms."
for they are the root of evil
from the roots of the kelipos,
for he accepted the Erev Rav,
for while they were still in Mitzrayim, etc.,
not to mix the Erev Rav among them;
you, who were humble and upright,
One always accepts the penitent, etc."
not in the days of David
nor in the days of Shlomo,"
after the fact they were converts;
(פֶּרֶק יג מֵהִלְכוֹת אִיסּוּרֵי בִּיאָה, הֲלָכָה טו)
in the days of David and Shlomo,
but did not reject them, etc.
the leaven in the dough branched out
For at the time of Mattan Torah it is written
that they would not have died,
that the Angel of Death would not
for "he is the Satan, he is the yetzer hara,
he is the Angel of Death,"
for if the first blemish of Adam HaRishon
death would not have been nullified.
and this refers to the deed of the Calf,
which was made through the Erev Rav,
And therefore Moshe Rabbeinu will come
from the level of Yaakov Avinu,
that there is in it no admixture
and he will take vengeance on the Erev Rav.
